name: flowdeck-monorepo
description: FlowDeck — visualize the plan-confirmation step of AI IDE conversations as an editable modular canvas

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowdeck/core && npm run build -w @flowdeck/web && npm run build -w @flowdeck/mcp
scripts.test:core: npm run build -w @flowdeck/core && node --test packages/core/test/graph.test.mjs packages/core/test/markdown.test.mjs packages/core/test/summary.test.mjs packages/core/test/normalize.test.mjs
